scope: Linked-heading structural calibration with plain controls, not an independent generalization test. The clean released model, actual Rawstep inputs/previous contexts and predictions were fixed before either Native browser. The initial verifier rejects all compound units; unknown scores stay unknown, while primary Native AX role/DOM-ID comparisons are physical diagnostics rather than logical-unit Navigation Accuracy. Preserve complete source AX locally for a later independently checked unit projection. Final control state is fixture health, not user-task success. No queue/completion/timing parity. Both profiles finish before inspecting experimental outcomes. Now inspected calibration/regression.

plan.sourceState: Model JS comes from the retained, fully installed-smoke-tested clean 18fbb06 tarball. Observer/generator source hashes describe the collection worktree with earlier pending diagnostics; these do not identify the model source.
plan.question: Does a linked heading form one reading unit in both Native browsers, and does its hint follow the outer link or heading? Compare plain link/heading controls and both nesting directions.
plan.hypothesis: The existing formatter has compound heading/link metadata, but the Native input verifier rejects it. Preserve primary Native AX role/ID/level and complete children to establish a measured projection; do not infer the read unit from speech or keyboard focus. Freeze the released model and all actual inputs before Native; inspect outcomes only after both profiles finish.
plan.protocol: Same shared HTML and complete command sequences in both Native browsers. Freeze actual Rawstep model outputs, semantic inputs, previous speech contexts and independent renderer DOM/control state before Native. Rawstep owns movement; no new navigation implementation. Speech data never selects targets or supplies model inputs.
plan.inputPolicy: Preserve exact diagnostic input and previousContext. For the Native verifier only, join the actual model target backendDOMNodeId to its independently read renderer DOM id; retain both original identity and mapping. This ID-only verification view does not alter model input or prediction. Container IDs retain actual model identities. Native target and previous ancestor context still require independent geometry/AX confirmation.
metrics: literal Full Speech Exact of actual model windows
plan.limits: Inspected-failure controlled calibration, not an independent evaluation. Action-sequence overlap is deliberate and recorded. The unchanged enabled-state oracle only checks fixture health, not task-generalization performance. A diagnostic input is not an AX/VO cursor oracle. Model 900ms observation windows and Native bounded receipt windows do not establish equal timing, causal attribution, completion or native queue behavior. Preserve every failed/missing/unmeasured row.

acquisition.scope: Calibrate Native linked-heading reading units and hints against the exact clean 18fbb06 installed-smoke-tested tarball. No new movement implementation. Both profiles must complete before outcome inspection or source changes. Source snapshots retained separately from frozen model JS.
acquisition.preflight: An earlier model-only freeze stopped on an empty health oracle for the plain heading. Kept its case files, plan and model directory unchanged; fixed only the health target in a new case directory/freeze before any Native execution. No Native observation preceded this repair.
